Flagship Student Initiative

EcoCode: Youth-Led Climate Tech Incubator

"EcoCode is a student-led STEAM incubator that empowers students in grades 5–8 to engineer real-world tech solutions for everyday environmental challenges."

Through our structured, zero-cost development sprint, collaborative student teams turn paper sketches into working software prototypes and showcase them live at an open community hackathon.

TARGET AUDIENCE

Grades 5–8

Middle school youth

ACCESSIBILITY

$0 Cost

100% free for students

OUTCOME

Hackathon

Live prototype demo

Follow @ecocode.hs Founded by Ayush Barot

The EcoCode Sprint Flow

1

Problem Ideation

Identifying community environmental challenges (waste, water, and energy efficiency).

2

Paper to Prototype

Transforming rough paper sketches into software logic, flowcharts, and digital wireframes.

3

Peer Mentorship

Hands-on student coaching guiding teams through introductory coding syntax and problem-solving.

4

Live Community Hackathon

Teams showcase working prototypes live to teachers, parents, and fellow classmates.

Athletic Leadership & Mentorship

Youth Soccer Coaching: Building Team Resilience & Vision

"Coaching youth soccer for over two years has taught me that true leadership isn't about control — it's about active trust, clear tactical communication, and empowering young athletes to make decisions with confidence."

For over 2 years, I have actively coached and mentored youth soccer players, leading technical training sessions, tactical match preparation, and fostering a growth-oriented team environment where discipline and sportsmanship go hand-in-hand.

Key Coaching Pillars

Technical Agility & Ball Mastery

Structuring purposeful drills covering first touch, precision passing, directional control, and dribbling under pressure to build individual confidence.

Tactical Vision & Positional Sense

Teaching youth players how to read passing lanes, support teammates off the ball, manage offensive transitions, and hold defensive shape.

Sportsmanship & Mental Toughness

Instilling unconditional respect for officials, opponents, and teammates, teaching kids how to bounce back from adversity and stay composed.
